title: "I feel like I haven't done much this year": the month-by-month proof you did
summary: Open with "I feel like I haven't done much this year", then prove yourself wrong with one real clip per month. AI helps you find and caption the wins.
why: Later's Instagram Reels trends list, updated November 27, 2026, added this format on November 20: the video opens with the line "I feel like I haven't done much this year", then shows clips labelled by month as proof. Our "How I've looked throughout the year" pack is about your look; this one is about what you actually got done.
steps: Write a quick list of anything you did each month, big or small. Paste it into a chat tool with the main prompt.
Use the list it gives back to find one photo or short clip for each month in your camera roll.
In your video editor, start with the opening line on a plain shot of you, then show each clip for about one second with its month label.
If a month has only a still photo, use the motion prompt to give it a gentle move, then post.

prompts.label: Main prompt: find the wins and write the labels
prompts.text: I'm making a short vertical video. It opens with the text "I feel like I haven't done much this year", then shows one clip per month as proof that I did. Here are my rough notes for each month: [January: ..., February: ..., March: ..., and so on]. Some months feel empty to me. For every month, pick the one thing that makes the best proof, even if it's small, like learning a recipe or finally fixing the closet door. Write a label for each of 2 to 6 words, in lowercase, starting with the month name. Then write a short, kind closing line for the last frame. Keep it honest: don't make anything sound bigger than it was.

prompts.label: Motion prompt: bring one still photo to life
prompts.text: Use this photo as the start. Keep the people, faces, clothes and background exactly the same. Make a 2-second vertical clip with a slow push-in and one small natural movement, like hands moving or a light breeze. No new objects, no text, no change to how anyone looks.

prompts.label: Variation: the tiny wins edition
prompts.text: I want to make an "I feel like I haven't done much this year" video using only tiny, everyday wins. Here is what I remember from this year: [list anything: habits kept, days you showed up, things you tried for the first time]. Sort them into the months they happened, pick the funniest or most relatable one for each month, and write a 2 to 6 word label for each. Suggest one month where the label can be a joke, like "march: survived."

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: what our shop did this year
prompts.text: I run [type of business] and I want to post "I feel like we haven't done much this year", then show one clip per month as proof. Here is what happened each month: [list new products, events, repairs, team moments, things you learned]. Pick one item per month, write a 2 to 6 word label for each, and give me a short thank-you line for the last frame. Don't make any claims about sales, customer numbers or results.

tips: Use real clips from your own year. The point is proof, so don't have AI invent moments that didn't happen.
Small wins count. A month labelled "learned to make bread" lands as well as a big trip.
Keep each clip to about one second so the whole video stays under 20 seconds.
Only show other people if they agreed, and say so if you used AI to add motion.
